item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-c8b79727cac19486","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 30 April 2023, Egypt's National Council for Artificial Intelligence launched the Egyptian Charter for Responsible AI, describing it as a framework for responsible AI development, deployment, management, and use; the charter included five values, 13 general guidelines, and 16 implementation guidelines.","question_ids":["1B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; the source attributes the launch to the National Council and communications minister, not personally to el-Sisi.","ruler_attribution":"Indirect state-level attribution; no direct presidential order is reported.","limitations":["The source reports adoption and design of the charter, not enforcement outcomes or resource allocation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c8b79727cac19486","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The charter requires government AI projects to undergo impact assessment and be supervised by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, with periodic reporting to the National AI Council; the charter is to be reviewed annually.","question_ids":["1B.9","8B.2","8B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Indirect state-level attribution; no direct presidential involvement is identified.","limitations":["The document does not establish whether these requirements were implemented, audited, or enforced during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2b1a7fae6051d56e","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"During the May 2023 Gaza escalation, the Egyptian-controlled Rafah crossing and adjacent Salah Ad Din gate operated as usual, allowing movement of goods and people between Gaza and Egypt, while Israeli-controlled crossings were closed.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.10","3B.9","6B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; describes the regional humanitarian context rather than an exclusively Egyptian presidential decision.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes operation of the crossing to Egyptian-controlled authorities, without naming el-Sisi.","limitations":["The report does not quantify the scale or humanitarian adequacy of Egyptian facilitation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b422ed0d68640869","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnesty reported that, from 1 October 2023, Egyptian authorities arrested and interrogated at least 196 people over unauthorized protests, alleged terrorism-related activity, or spreading false news, while genuine opposition candidates were barred from the presidential election.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; Amnesty reports events and conditions before the December 2023 election.","ruler_attribution":"The report concerns Egyptian authorities under el-Sisi's government but does not identify a personal presidential order for each arrest or candidacy decision.","limitations":["The source is an external human-rights assessment and does not provide a judicial determination for every case."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b422ed0d68640869","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Ahmed Altantawy and campaign members were prosecuted in connection with efforts to collect presidential-election endorsements; Amnesty reported obstacles and intimidation at public notary offices, 21 campaign supporters in pre-trial detention, and alleged government involvement in Predator spyware infection of Altantawy's phone.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.9","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The reported prosecutions and surveillance concern state authorities; personal direction by el-Sisi is not established in the document.","limitations":["Spyware involvement is reported as Citizen Lab's high-confidence assessment, not a court finding; the report does not establish el-Sisi's personal knowledge."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b422ed0d68640869","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In October 2023, security forces violently dispersed peaceful Palestine-solidarity and other protests, with plainclothes men beating protesters; at least 56 protesters remained in pre-trial detention, at least six were forcibly disappeared, and 14 teachers were arbitrarily detained after a protest.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The facts concern Egyptian security forces under the sitting government; the document does not prove a personal order by el-Sisi.","limitations":["The source reports allegations and human-rights-group figures; individual legal outcomes are not supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b422ed0d68640869","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"On 23 October 2023, the army reportedly used live ammunition to disperse peaceful protesters in Rafah demanding return to North Sinai communities from which they had been forcibly displaced; at least 47 people were ordered into pre-trial detention.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The reported conduct is attributed to the army and military court; personal presidential authorization is not established.","limitations":["The account relies on Amnesty's reporting and the Sinai Foundation for Human Rights; no independent inquiry finding is provided."]},{"source_id":"SRC-114e4c0853a377e1","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In an official 25 April 2023 speech, el-Sisi framed Sinai's security policy as a continuing battle against terrorists and takfiris, praised the armed forces and police for ten years of counterterrorism sacrifices, and pledged continued vigilance, readiness, protection, and development of Sinai.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.9","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct presidential statement.","limitations":["The speech states objectives and framing but provides no independent evidence of civilian-protection safeguards, outcomes, or accountability."]},{"source_id":"SRC-114e4c0853a377e1","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"El-Sisi presented Sinai development as a government battle requiring major effort, patience, and work to provide the region with a new reality, linking security protection with development.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","6B.1","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct presidential statement.","limitations":["No budget, implementation milestone, service result, or distributional outcome is specified."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cd219ce1cea57d04","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In a 27 September 2023 speech, el-Sisi attributed Egypt's foreign-exchange and economic crisis to global price increases, the Russia-Ukraine crisis, higher interest rates, and capital outflows, while stating that Egypt would continue development projects and economic growth to protect food and energy security.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.9","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct presidential statement.","limitations":["The speech is an official claim and does not independently verify the causal attribution, policy funding, or results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cd219ce1cea57d04","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"El-Sisi stated that eight years of extensive development work had produced robustness and resilience in Egypt's national economy and that the government was exerting maximum efforts to mitigate hardship while maintaining development momentum.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","5B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct presidential statement.","limitations":["The claimed economic resilience and development effects are not independently measured in the document."]},{"source_id":"SRC-18b847e70423ce8b","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"As of December 2023, Egypt's Takaful and Karama cash-transfer program reached 4.67 million households, approximately 17 million citizens; 74% of cardholders were women.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The quantitative result is explicitly reported as of December 2023, although the page was published in 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The program is administered by Egypt's Ministry of Social Solidarity; the source does not identify a direct el-Sisi decision.","limitations":["Coverage is not the same as adequacy, uptake, or improved life chances; the source does not provide 2023 outcome comparisons."]},{"source_id":"SRC-18b847e70423ce8b","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The Takaful component provides monthly conditional transfers to poor households with children under 18 subject to health and education conditions, while Karama provides unconditional transfers to poor older people, orphans, widows, and persons with disabilities.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.7","6B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The program operated during 2023; the source was published in 2024 and describes its structure retrospectively.","ruler_attribution":"State program attribution through the Ministry of Social Solidarity; no personal presidential direction is shown.","limitations":["The source does not report exclusion rates, appeals, actual service quality, or whether conditionality caused hardship."]},{"source_id":"SRC-18b847e70423ce8b","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The Takaful and Karama system used a dynamic social registry to link beneficiaries to health insurance, food subsidies, and other social programs, and relied on 15,000 social and community workers to deliver outreach and behavior-change messages.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.4","6B.5","6B.9","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The source describes the system in a 2024 feature and includes the program's operation through 2023; exact 2023 staffing status is not separately dated.","ruler_attribution":"Program administration is attributed to the Ministry of Social Solidarity and partners, not personally to el-Sisi.","limitations":["No independent audit or evidence of equal territorial performance is provided."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-4209d26dfbdfc6b6","SRC-5a7be9ab225c86bb","SRC-71c18703714de316","SRC-2532659c2bb39ebe","SRC-ae5048cf0b037d6f","SRC-ef067fd368873c9b"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents describe general treaty provisions, a later period, or material without Egypt-specific 2023 findings and therefore do not support a concrete fact for el-Sisi during 2023."]}
